subject: computer-science
title: Buses and the Fetch-Decode-Execute Cycle
welcome_lead: Trace data, address and control across buses through every instruction cycle.
meta_desc: IBDP CS adventure on system buses and the fetch-decode-execute cycle.
final_note: Every instruction: fetch, decode, execute, repeat!

concepts.def: Get instruction from memory at PC.
CU interprets the instruction in IR.
ALU or memory performs the operation.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Address bus width sets max memory; 32 bits = 4 GiB addressable.

Data bus width sets transfer size per cycle.

PC -> MAR; memory[MAR] -> MDR; MDR -> IR.

PC is incremented to point at next instruction.

CU decodes IR opcode.

Operands sent to ALU; result written to ACC or memory.
